find:
note: source.dirty
      ? 'the checkout was dirty when this was captured; these commands reproduce the commit, not this tree'
      : null,
killedBy: reproduction (issue #815) says so when the checkout was dirty, and when no Playwright version was resolved
why: The reproduction command names a commit. When the tree was dirty it reproduces the commit, not the capture, and a reviewer has to be told which.
